meta.description: Net-new events merged during this refresh. Window: 2026-09-20 to 09-25. Accenture added two official signals (Volvo Cars joins the Accenture-Google Cloud Horizon open-source gen-AI software platform 09-22; strategic investment in Within's work-to-agent platform 09-23). Deloitte launched its AI and agentic AI enabled M&A Platform (09-22). KPMG announced the Client Technology & Innovation Group to build AI-native businesses (09-22, effective Oct 1). BCG merged three of six AI publications this week (Five Ways AI Front-Runners 09-24, Frontline Ops AI by BCG X 09-24, Why AI Sales Can't Stop at the Close 09-25); the other three were held to avoid same-week stacking. L.E.K., McKinsey, Bain, PwC, EY, Capgemini, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, FTI Consulting, Alvarez & Marsal, Roland Berger, Strategy&, and Monitor Deloitte had no verifiable net-new public AI signals in the window.

events.title: Deloitte 发布 AI 与 agentic AI 驱动的 M&A Platform，覆盖交易执行全流程
events.title_en: Deloitte expands AI and agentic AI capabilities with an M&A platform for smarter deal execution
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-09-22（纽约）发布 M&A Platform，把 AI 与 agentic AI 嵌入并购交易的目标筛选、尽调与执行流程，帮助客户更智能、更流畅地完成交易。这是 Deloitte 首次把 agentic AI 产品化到 M&A 这一高价值交易场景，属于自有平台资产扩张。
events.summary_en: On September 22, 2026, Deloitte launched its M&A Platform, embedding AI and agentic AI into target screening, diligence, and deal execution to enable smarter, more streamlined transactions, productizing agentic AI for the high-value M&A scenario as a proprietary platform asset.

events.title: Volvo Cars 成为 Accenture 与 Google Cloud 开源平台 Horizon 的首席行业伙伴：测试提速 9 倍、开发成本降 40%
events.title_en: Volvo Cars becomes lead industry partner for Horizon, the open-source gen-AI software platform by Accenture and Google Cloud
events.summary: Accenture 与 Google Cloud 于 2026-09-22 宣布 Volvo Cars 出任 Horizon 平台首席行业伙伴。Horizon 是构建在 Google Cloud 上的开源软件开发平台，面向软件定义汽车的 gen-AI 开发（尤其 Android Automotive 信息娱乐系统），官方量化了测试提速最高 9 倍、信息娱乐开发成本降低最高 40%。这是 Accenture 平台资产获得头部车企背书的客户证明。
events.summary_en: On September 22, 2026, Accenture and Google Cloud announced Volvo Cars as lead industry partner for Horizon, an open-source software development platform on Google Cloud for gen-AI-driven software-defined vehicle development, with quantified results of up to 9x faster testing and up to 40% lower infotainment development costs.

events.title: KPMG 新设 Client Technology & Innovation Group：整合创新、AI 与生态，目标是打造 AI-native 业务
events.title_en: KPMG announces Client Technology & Innovation Group to build AI-native businesses
events.summary: KPMG 于 2026-09-22 宣布设立 Client Technology & Innovation Group（10 月 1 日生效），由 15 年老将 Todd Lohr 出任副主席并直接向 CEO 汇报，把创新、AI 与生态系统整合到一个组织内，建设 AI-native 业务并加速新业务孵化，被视为 KPMG AI 部门的重组升级。
events.summary_en: On September 22, 2026, KPMG announced its Client Technology & Innovation Group (effective October 1), led by 15-year veteran Todd Lohr as Vice Chair reporting directly to the CEO, consolidating innovation, AI, and ecosystems under one umbrella to build AI-native businesses and accelerate new ventures.

events.title: Accenture 战略投资 Within，结合其 work-to-agent 平台加速企业级 AI 采纳
events.title_en: Accenture invests in Within to map work for AI and accelerate enterprise adoption
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-09-23 宣布战略投资 Within，并把自家 AI 交付规模与 Within 的 work-to-agent 平台结合，解决企业流程可见性与自动化的问题，帮助客户在企业范围加速 AI 采纳。这是 Accenture 在 agentic AI 供给侧的又一资本布局。
events.summary_en: On September 23, 2026, Accenture announced a strategic investment in Within, combining its AI delivery scale with Within's work-to-agent platform to tackle process visibility and automation and help clients accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.

events.title: BCG 发布《Five Ways That AI Front-Runners Change How Work Gets Done》：领先者重设计工作方式
events.title_en: BCG publishes Five Ways That AI Front-Runners Change How Work Gets Done
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-09-24 发布研究，总结 AI 领先企业在工作方式上的五种重构做法，延续其'从工具采纳到工作流重设计'的研究主线。
events.summary_en: On September 24, 2026, BCG published research distilling five ways AI front-runner firms redesign how work gets done, continuing its adoption-to-workflow-redesign research line.

events.title: BCG X 发布 Frontline Ops AI 资产：把 AI 推向一线运营的代表性产品化输出
events.title_en: BCG X releases Frontline Ops AI, a productized asset for frontline operations
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-09-24 在 BCG X 产品库发布 Frontline Ops AI（从预测到排班的技术方案展示），把 AI 落到一线运营的技术资产层面，是 BCG X 少见的对外产品化输出信号。
events.summary_en: On September 24, 2026, BCG X published Frontline Ops AI in its product library, showcasing the technology behind forecast-to-shift frontline operations and marking a rare productized asset signal from BCG X.

events.title: BCG 发布《Why AI Sales Can't Stop at the Close》：AI 产品需要新的商业化模型
events.title_en: BCG publishes Why AI Sales Can't Stop at the Close
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-09-25 发布研究，主张 AI 产品的商业化不能止步于签单，需要新的 commercial model 来承接交付与价值兑现。
events.summary_en: On September 25, 2026, BCG published research arguing that AI sales cannot stop at the close and that AI products need a new commercial model to carry delivery and value realization.
